scope: Selected combined boundary, distance, and centroid-box example; occurrences are not scientific validation or complete plugin coverage.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Boundary and Section Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Shrink the image bounding box using frame-contact feature centroids in feature-row order, then flag centroids on or outside its faces.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Boundary and Section Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Count unlike-label in-bounds face neighbors per cell, including label-0 contacts and excluding out-of-image faces.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Boundary and Section Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: For each positive feature, count cells with at least one unlike in-bounds neighbor and divide by cell count.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Boundary and Section Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Estimate voxel-face surface area divided by NumElements-based volume and sphericity on the isotropic 0.25 micrometer grid.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Boundary and Section Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Find each feature’s largest grid-aligned XY slice area in square micrometers.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Boundary and Section Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Find each feature’s largest grid-aligned XZ slice area in square micrometers.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Boundary and Section Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Find each feature’s largest grid-aligned YZ slice area in square micrometers.

filters.pipeline: (01) Small IN100 Boundary and Section Measurements.d3dpipeline
filters.purpose: Count face-sharing grid steps from positive cells to the nearest unlike-label in-bounds boundary seed; background remains -1. No TJ/QP maps.
